name: profile
description: bensonjt.github.io/profile: static site. Node is only for the lint, test and build tools below. The lint step covers the AI Builder files; the older pages predate it (site.css and several pages already fail the stylelint and Prettier style rules).

scripts.test: npm run lint && python3 tools/tests/check_links.py && python3 tools/leland/build_single.py && node tools/tests/test_decks.js && npm run test:fitmap
scripts.lint: htmlhint "*.html" && stylelint css/builder.css css/fit-map.css && prettier --check "ai-builder*.html" fit-analyzer-map.html css/builder.css css/fit-map.css js/builder.js js/fit-map.js tools/tests/test_decks.js tools/tests/test_fitmap.js package.json
